subject.title: Support session-level environment variables for ACP sessions

question: Should OpenClaw expose per-spawn ACP session environment injection, and what credential-safe boundary should it use?
rationale: The requested API can move credential-like values from a model-callable tool input into host ACP harness processes, so automation should not choose the trust, redaction, persistence, and precedence policy.

options.title: Design a scoped ACP env contract first
options.body: Approve the capability only behind explicit validation, redaction, source-of-trust, persistence, and ACPX/session-reuse rules before implementation.

options.title: Defer to per-agent or per-call env work
options.body: Keep this issue open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/93425 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80329 clarify the permanent env-source model.

options.title: Reject model-callable env maps
options.body: Decline raw `sessions_spawn.env` and require operators to use configured SecretRef or plugin-owned auth surfaces instead.

recommendation.title: Design a scoped ACP env contract first
recommendation.body: Approve the capability only behind explicit validation, redaction, source-of-trust, persistence, and ACPX/session-reuse rules before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the ACP spawn/session architecture and are the strongest history signal for the owner boundary this decision would change.
